## Switches tell the truth

- After you flip a switch, the app checks the device. If the setting did not change (for example
  cellular data on a TV stick), the switch goes back to the device's real state and a message
  says **This setting could not be changed on this device.**
- **Data Saver** no longer shows as off when it is on.
- Flipping the same switch twice quickly no longer leaves it in the wrong position.

## Updating

On Windows, use the **Update now** banner or Settings > Updates (from 1.6.2 on). On Linux the
banner opens this page. Versions before 1.6.2 must be updated by hand once.
